items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury; McVay says not making great progress and team being cautious though not long-term.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness; second DNP; McVay candid on lack of progress
items.implication: Likely OUT Week 3 vs DEN; monitor Fri report

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Elevated risk of missing Week 3; Schultz target bump if out
items.opportunity: TE/WR volume for Schultz and others

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after knee surgery (MCL/meniscus, ACL intact); season-ending, full recovery expected.
items.why: Surgery confirmed; sources on full recovery but 2026 season over
items.implication: Jameis Winston likely starter; Giants pass game chaos

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers DNP second straight day (hamstring); looking like missing second consecutive game, travel to Brazil complicates.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated after Week 1 explosion; history from Aug 20 joint practice
items.implication: Likely OUT again vs DAL in Brazil

items.text: Bears QB Tyson Bagent officially DNP first practice of week (concussion est.); all signs point to Case Keenum starting vs PHI.
Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI results; expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: Good MRI; suited up and expects to play
items.implication: Clear for MNF; no major handcuff elevation

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games across 3 seasons); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role, AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead back; Dillon handcuff

items.text: TNF spots: Has Marshawn Lloyd totally blown chance/ceded backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Is Penix healthy enough to revive London and Pitts? Reed absence more 2TE sets? Packers OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.why: Role questions post-injuries/usage shifts for TNF
items.implication: Monitor Lloyd cede, Penix boost to ATL pass catchers, Watson in 2TE

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 42% of them; results 5-35-3 and 8-195-2 in the two games missed.
items.why: Route/target monopoly data when Nacua out; explosion results
items.implication: Adams must-start/WR1 upside if Nacua sits again

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring Aug 20 joint practice; seemed fine then exploded Week 1 (5-150-1 first half) before aggravating; hasn't practiced full since; Brazil travel.
items.why: Injury origin and aggravation details + travel risk
items.implication: High chance misses another; fade or handcuff

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs soft Dallas run D + high prop

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
